g.text: No Buyer response -> SYSTEM timeout, never fake REJECT/CONFIRM.
Return transit remains RESULT_NOTIFIED with TO_SELLER shipment.
Tracking/event alone cannot establish actual returned receipt.
Receipt window = trusted TO_BUYER event server time+72h.
Separate from result window; tracking alone never starts AUTO.
Fresh DB clock after locks governs writes; report blocks AUTO.
Actual receipt commits before refund attempt.
Failure remains HELD and retries the same policy/cause once.
Original charge unchanged; Product CANCELLED; review forbidden.
REJECT / timeout / negative; dispatch then actual Seller or Admin receipt
trusted Admin demo TO_BUYER event / receipt+72h
report without waiting for event / HELD
timely Buyer receipt OR eligible AUTO / one RELEASE
scoped audited Admin non-receipt / full refund
separate settlement / item-only or full by policy/cause
Six no-HTTP jobs; inspection overdue escalates only.
Backend candidate is separate from E / shared / Android acceptance.
